Subject: Lumeno banking proof and initial PO routing notes

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the bank certification and signed W9 for Lumeno Systems (US entity). We’ve also included a short CSV sample that shows how Lumeno would like remittance references populated: InvoiceRef|PO|CustomerID.

A couple notes:
- Bank: First National Bank, acct masked: ****2345 (ACH routing 111000025) — we can provide a bank letter if required.
- We operate on Net-30 after invoice receipt; prefer ACH for US payouts.
- For cross-border payments, we can accept USD wires to the same USD account; let us know if Redwood needs IBAN/SWIFT.

Attached: Lumeno_Banking_Certificate.pdf, Lumeno_W9_signed.pdf

Next steps requested from your side: confirm micro-deposit schedule and the PO field Redwood will use to link invoices to payments.

Best,
Aria Gomez
Head of Finance Operations
Lumeno Systems
aria@lumeno.co | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00

Hi Aria —

Appreciate the docs and the CSV sample — that’s exactly what we need. Quick confirmation of our side:

1) Micro-deposit: Finance will send two micro-deposits (USD) to acct ****2345 this afternoon. Please confirm once you see them and paste the amounts here.
2) PO mapping: Redwood expects a PO token in the invoice JSON field called "po_reference" and a separate "invoice_ref" for remittance reconciliation. Your CSV example maps cleanly — we’ll map InvoiceRef->invoice_ref and PO->po_reference.
3) Effective date: When would you like Redwood to begin routing payments to this account? We can flip the vendor record the day after micro-deposit verification.

I’m looping in Priyom (vendor onboarding) and Laura (payables) to handle the micro-deposit and the vendor code.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0109

Thanks,
